unsupported_brands: Any brand that is not an explicit member of supported_brands, including Rolex, Omega, Cartier, Tudor, and an omitted brand.
supported_image_assumptions: The request declares one of the five supported brands before inference.
The image is a watch photograph in the same general product-photo setting as the five-brand catalog.
The authenticity head is used only after that declaration. It is not a brand identifier.
known_dataset_limitations: 30000 audited images, 15000 authentic and 15000 fake, five brands only.
No verified product or SKU identity.
final_test_status: 3006 in-distribution samples scored once. ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, and F1 are 1.0 on the calibrated report. False-authentic and false-fake counts are 0. The test was not reopened in this phase.
calibration_status: Temperature fitted on 2998 calibration samples and frozen. Not refit in this phase.
brand_declaration_warning: The supplied brand is a user-declared scope parameter and is not independently verified from the image.
brand_verification: Brand verification is outside the current model scope.
